title: Licensed cannabis producer (New York State)
description: One state-licensed business that grows, processes or brands cannabis in New York. A record describes a LICENCE, not a company: an operator holding a cultivator licence and a processor licence produces two records. Unlike a dispensary, a producer has no public street address in the state registry — only a county and a region — so this schema does not pretend to one.

id.description: Stable URL slug, derived from the entity name and the licence number's tail. Must never change once published.

licenseNumber.description: Licence number verbatim from the state registry. The primary key of truth: never invent, never reformat.

licenseType.description: MICROBUSINESS appears in both this register and the dispensary one: the licence permits growing and selling, and the same licence number links the two.

operationalStatus.description: What the registry publishes about whether the licensee is operating. UNKNOWN where it publishes nothing — never guessed.

tier.description: Registry tier code, e.g. CCULT_OUTDOOR_T5. Kept verbatim: the tiers encode canopy size and are not ours to reinterpret.

cultivation.description: How they grow, as the registry states it. Null where the registry says nothing — which is different from all-false.

primaryContactName.description: The contact the state publishes for the licence. This is a named individual: it is here because the state publishes it and because reaching a licensee is the point of this register, and it must not be rendered on a public page. A public record being public does not make republishing a person's name on a directory a good idea.

brands.description: Brand names seen on collected dispensary shelves that resolve to this licensee. Each carries how the link was made, because a brand is not a licence: national brands are produced under contract by a New York processor whose registered name is different, and no amount of string comparison bridges that.

match.description: EXACT: the brand and the licensee name normalise identically. TOKEN_SUBSET: one name's significant words are contained in the other's — good enough to look at, not good enough to assert. MANUAL: a person checked it.

counties.description: Every county the registry lists this licence operating in. A cultivator with two sites appears twice in the registry, differing only by location: taking the first row would silently lose the second county.

regions.description: The state's own economic-development regions for those sites, kept verbatim rather than mapped.

locationCount.description: How many locations the registry publishes for this licence.
